qt: to the Commission Dolors Montserrat (PPE) Subject:

Spain recorded 32 942 irregular arrivals between January and October 2026; 8.9 % more than in 2025, not counting the incursion of 80 000 people in Ceuta in July. In addition, there were 7 188 arrivals in the Balearic Islands and 734 in Melilla. Migratory pressure continues to intensify in the Canary Islands, with more than 3 200 people arriving in the first five days of November alone. This is compounded by the dramatic human cost of the Atlantic route, with 34 people killed in a shipwreck off Senegal’s coast and further deaths in Canarian waters. The President of the Canary Islands has consequently drawn attention to the fact that the reception facilities on El Hierro are overwhelmed and has called for the European Union institutions to intervene. In light of the foregoing: 1.
What is the Commission’s assessment of the Spanish Government’s management of migration in light of this increase and the overwhelming of reception facilities?
What assistance has Spain requested from Frontex in 2026, what resources have been deployed and with what results?

What oversight will the Commission exercise to ensure that the external borders are protected and that the Sánchez administration effectively applies the Return Regulation so that failings by Spain do not compromise Schengen?
